headline: TRITN spikes 50.00% on open gap with volume 2.82×, the biggest single‑day move in coverage today.
market_take: Food stocks led the rally, with F&D up 18.75%, XBIO gaining 14.29% and AQUA rising 10.00% on strong intraday activity. Property showed mixed signals: ESTAR (+10.53%) and CI (+9.09%) advanced, while KC fell 33.33% and PF dropped 20.00% amid volume spikes. Construction materials and REITs saw extreme price gaps, notably HPF and MIPF at -100.00%, and several securities triggered trading‑sign alerts and filing disclosures.

sector_notes.note: F&D (+18.75%) and XBIO (+14.29%) posted the largest gains; both flagged for intraday moves. AQUA added +10.00% intraday. SST filed a CFO resignation, adding corporate‑governance focus.
ESTAR (+10.53%) and CI (+9.09%) rose, while KC (-33.33%) and PF (-20.00%) plunged with high volume spikes. JCK lifted its CB trading sign and disclosed a default on interest payments.
TRITN surged +50.00% on open gap; PLE gained +12.50% intraday. BJCHI reported capital‑change filings and share‑repurchase activity.
HPF and MIPF each showed -100.00% open gaps, indicating possible suspension. QHBREIT announced a capital reduction.
PPPM recorded a volume spike of 23.5σ, the highest across all alerts.
GEL experienced a -33.33% open gap and a +50.00% intraday move, while DCC posted a 6.3σ volume spike.
